verdict.rationale: Oyster documents that submitting an EOR employment kicks off onboarding and contract generation, that agreements go out for signature, and it advertises fast compliant onboarding. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-serve new-hire flow that collects W-4, I-9, or bank details before day one. That leaves only adjacent onboarding and contract features, which do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send a new hire a self-serve onboarding flow that collects W-4, I-9, and bank details before day one
